target.title: fix(openai): bound Codex image generation no-body response reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a sibling OOM gap in OpenAI Codex OAuth image generation. The Codex Responses SSE path already bounds streamed bodies in `readResponseBodyText`, but the `!response.body` branch still called `response.text()` and only checked `MAX_CODEX_IMAGE_SSE_BYTES` after buffering the full payload. A faulty or hostile endpoint returning a body without a readable stream could still grow gateway memory without bound before the size guard fired.

## Why This Change Was Made

The no-body branch now routes through the shared bounded response reader (`readResponseWithLimit`) at `MAX_CODEX_IMAGE_SSE_BYTES` (64 MiB) and reuses the existing Codex image size-limit error string.

This follows the same invariant as the existing streamed Codex image SSE guard and recent provider bounded-read hardening:

- streamed Codex image SSE responses remain incrementally capped and cancelled on overflow
- no-body Codex image responses now fail closed through the shared bounded reader instead of post-hoc `response.text()` length checks
- loopback transport proof exercises the production Codex OAuth image path over real HTTP on `127.0.0.1`

## User Impact

Operators using Codex OAuth image generation through the Responses transport are protected when a provider returns an oversized payload on the no-body response path. Valid Codex image SSE responses continue to work unchanged.

## Evidence

Loopback transport proof: I ran the production Codex OAuth `generateImage` path against a local HTTP server on `127.0.0.1`. This uses the real `postJsonRequest` / `fetch` path, real HTTP `Response` streams, OAuth auth stubbing only, and no mocked `postJsonRequest`.

```text
$ node scripts/openclaw-openai-codex-image-loopback-proof.mjs
{
  "proof": "openai codex image loopback",
  "valid": {
    "mode": "valid-codex-image-sse-over-loopback",
    "ok": true,
    "images": 1,
    "cancelObserved": false,
    "payloadBytes": 277,
    "ms": 1154
  },
  "oversizedStream": {
    "mode": "oversized-stream-cancel-over-loopback",
    "ok": true,
    "error": "OpenAI Codex image generation response exceeded size limit",
    "cancelObserved": true,
    "payloadBytes": 70254592,
    "ms": 689
  },
  "oversizedNoBody": {
    "mode": "oversized-no-body-over-loopback",
    "ok": true,
    "error": "OpenAI Codex image generation response exceeded size limit",
    "bodyNullSimulated": true,
    "payloadBytes": 67108865,
    "ms": 653
  }
}
```

Targeted unit proof: the existing provider tests cover the streamed and no-body Codex image overflow branches deterministically in-process.

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.test.ts -t "oversized Codex OAuth"
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed | 61 skipped (64)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard
```

Loopback Vitest wrapper:

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.loopback.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose
 ✓ extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.loopback.test.ts > OpenAI Codex image generation loopback proof > runs valid and oversized Codex image reads over loopback HTTP
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard
```

```text
$ node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.ts extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.loopback-proof.ts extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.loopback.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

```text
$ node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.ts extensions/openai/image-generation-provider.loopback-proof.ts
# passed
```

```text
$ git diff --check
# passed
```

Notes for reviewers:

- The no-body loopback case uses a real loopback payload and then simulates `response.body === null`, matching the production branch that cannot be triggered reliably from a normal streamed fetch alone.
- This PR does not add or migrate persistent state.
- Autoreview closeout was attempted locally; the Codex engine failed on this workstation because `glm-5.2` is unavailable for the configured ChatGPT account.

AI-assisted: built with Codex. I understand the change: it replaces the post-hoc no-body Codex image SSE read with `readResponseWithLimit` at the existing 64 MiB cap and adds loopback transport proof for the production Codex OAuth image path.
